entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Oh let Israel say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Oh let the house of Aaron say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Oh let them that fear Jehovah say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: I called upon Jah in distress; Jah answered me [and set me] in a large place.

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: Jehovah is for me, I will not fear; what can man do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: Jehovah is for me among them that help me; and I shall see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in man;

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in nobles.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All nations encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They encompassed me, yea, encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They encompassed me like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: Thou hast thrust hard at me that I might fall; but Jehovah helped me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: My strength and song is Jah, and he is become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The voice of triumph and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly;

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Jah.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: Jah hath chastened me sore; but he hath not given me over unto death.

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: ¶Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them; Jah will I praise.

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This is the gate of Jehovah: the righteous shall enter therein.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will give thee thanks, for thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: [The] stone which the builders rejected hath become the head of the corner:

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This is of Jehovah; it is wonderful in our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This is the day that Jehovah hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Oh save, Jehovah, I beseech thee; Jehovah, I beseech thee, oh send prosperity!

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah. We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: Jehovah is *God, and he hath given us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, --up to the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: Thou art my *God, and I will give thee thanks; my God, I will exalt thee.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
